page_title: MCI 3-0 CRY | Manchester City v Crystal Palace 13/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Stuart Attwell has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
90+6' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
84' 3 - 0 Goal! Rayan Cherki manages to prod the ball to Savinho (Manchester City) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom left corner. 3:0.

84' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
82' Pep Guardiola decides to make a substitution. Phil Foden will be replaced by John Stones (Manchester City).
82' A substitution has been made. Daniel Munoz is replaced by Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace).
81' Yellow card! It's like Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Stuart Attwell agrees and books him.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bernardo Silva trots off the pitch and is replaced by Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City).
79' Pep Guardiola has decided to make a change. Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) replaces Omar Marmoush.
75' The game has come to an end for Brennan Johnson. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace).
74' Gianluigi Donnarumma leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace).
72' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
69' Manchester City are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
66' Marc Guehi (Manchester City) commits a rough foul. Stuart Attwell stops the game and makes a call. Crystal Palace get a free kick.

65' Phil Foden (Manchester City) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Stuart Attwell has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Crystal Palace win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
64' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
60' Oliver Glasner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) replacing Yeremy Pino.
60' Here is a change. Jean-Philippe Mateta is going off and Oliver Glasner gives the last tactical orders to Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace).
60' Will Hughes comes off the pitch to be replaced by Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace).
60' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post.
60' A first-time shot by Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
58' Pep Guardiola prepares a substitution. Josko Gvardiol is replaced by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).
58' Substitution. Matheus Nunes will be replaced by Nathan Ake (Manchester City).
57' Manchester City can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
52' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Stuart Attwell didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
51' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Manchester City) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
48' The resulting corner from Phil Foden (Manchester City) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the left post.

43' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Dean Henderson displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
43' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Rayan Ait-Nouri (Manchester City) takes it short.
43' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
40' 2 - 0 Goal! Phil Foden plays it to Omar Marmoush (Manchester City), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Dean Henderson. 2:0.
38' The resulting set piece from Manchester City is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
36' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
34' A corner kick by Crystal Palace is thwarted by the well prepared Gianluigi Donnarumma (Manchester City).

33' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) gets inside the box and tries to beat Gianluigi Donnarumma with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. The referee points to the corner flag and Crystal Palace will take a corner.
32' 1 - 0 Goal! Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) takes a short pass from Phil Foden in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.

28' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Manchester City) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Stuart Attwell with no other option than to blow for a foul. Crystal Palace will take a free kick near the side line.
24' The linesman raises his flag. Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is adjudged offside.
21' Dangerous play by Rayan Ait-Nouri (Manchester City). Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. Crystal Palace are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
20' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Manchester City) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the left post.
18' Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
16' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) makes a strong challenge and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Manchester City.
13' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky!
13' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) will deliver the corner kick.

12' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Crystal Palace force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
10' Manchester City work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
9' Savinho (Manchester City) takes a short corner kick.
9' Manchester City have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
8' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Manchester City) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
7' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
6' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
2' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
1' The first half has started.
Crystal Palace will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Stuart Attwell.
